_about: Each clip's shown title and its hover description, by '<category folder>/<file name>'. Clips not listed here use their file name.

combat & battlegrounds/lock on system.title: Lock-On Targeting
combat & battlegrounds/lock on system.desc: Locks onto the target closest to screen center. Over-the-shoulder camera on its own render step, the character auto-faces the target, a see-through highlight marks it, and it releases on death or distance.

combat & battlegrounds/finisher cutscene.title: Finisher Cutscene
combat & battlegrounds/finisher cutscene.desc: A scripted finisher with its own camera sequence. Both characters are locked into the move while it plays, then the result is applied once it ends.

combat & battlegrounds/ground smash skil.title: Ground Smash Skill
combat & battlegrounds/ground smash skil.desc: A multi-hit skill ending in a ground slam: hit detection per phase, knockback, and a crater with debris that clears itself after the hit.

combat & battlegrounds/grab slam skill.title: Grab & Slam Skill
combat & battlegrounds/grab slam skill.desc: A grab that holds the target through the whole animation, then slams and launches them, with VFX timed to the animation's keyframes.

combat & battlegrounds/m1 combo.title: 4-Hit M1 Combo
combat & battlegrounds/m1 combo.desc: A 4-hit basic combo with a combo counter, reset timer and knockback on the last hit. Client-side prediction starts the swing the moment you click.

combat & battlegrounds/counter.title: Counter
combat & battlegrounds/counter.desc: A counter stance: getting hit inside its window cancels the attacker's move and hits back with its own animation.

combat & battlegrounds/perfect block.title: Perfect Block
combat & battlegrounds/perfect block.desc: Blocking right before a hit lands gives a perfect block: the attacker is stunned and the defender gets a free opening.

combat & battlegrounds/dashes.title: Combat Dashes
combat & battlegrounds/dashes.desc: Directional dashes with their own animations, trails and cooldowns, usable mid-combo.

combat & battlegrounds/front dash finish.title: Front Dash Finisher
combat & battlegrounds/front dash finish.desc: A forward dash that turns into a finishing strike when it connects, chaining straight out of the combo.

combat & battlegrounds/awakening animati.title: Awakening Transformation
combat & battlegrounds/awakening animati.desc: The awakening sequence: a full-screen transformation with camera work, effects and a powered-up moveset afterwards.

guns & shooter/running and shooting.title: Run & Gun
guns & shooter/running and shooting.desc: Shooting while sprinting: the aim, recoil and arm sway keep working on the move, and every shot is checked on the server.

guns & shooter/dummy limb shots.title: Limb Dismemberment
guns & shooter/dummy limb shots.desc: Each hit checks which body part was hit: an upper arm or a leg comes off and flies with the bullet's momentum, a wrist hit bleeds, and a headshot kills. Physics is owned by the shooter, so it reacts instantly.

guns & shooter/dummy shoot preview.title: Ragdoll & Blood Impacts
guns & shooter/dummy shoot preview.desc: Hit reactions on a ragdoll dummy: blood drops that fly in real arcs and splat on the ground, wound stains on the body, then a respawn.

guns & shooter/cursor follow aim.title: Cursor-Follow Aiming
guns & shooter/cursor follow aim.desc: The arm and the gun follow the mouse, smoothed and limited to natural angles, and other players see the same aim.

guns & shooter/inferno gun skin + previe.title: Inferno Skin & Preview
guns & shooter/inferno gun skin + previe.desc: A gun skin with its own textures and fire effects, and a preview of it in the inventory before you equip it.

pets & rng/egg hatching.title: Click-to-Crack Egg Hatching
pets & rng/egg hatching.desc: Every click cracks the egg somewhere new and its rarity's light leaks through the cracks. Common pets open fast; Legendary and Mythic take more clicks, charge up and burst. The server rolls the pet.

pets & rng/mythic hatch.title: Mythic Hatch
pets & rng/mythic hatch.desc: The rarest tier: a longer charge-up, a screen tint, rays, sparkles and a screen shake. The odds come from weighted chances with luck and a pity counter.

pets & rng/rainbow mutation.title: Rainbow Mutation
pets & rng/rainbow mutation.desc: Mutations roll separately from the pet (Gold, Diamond, Rainbow) and multiply its power. Rainbow pets cycle their colors.

pets & rng/auto hatch.title: Auto Hatch
pets & rng/auto hatch.desc: Opens eggs on its own, three at a time when you can afford it, and stops when you walk away or run out of coins.

pets & rng/pet inventory + following.title: Pet Inventory & Following
pets & rng/pet inventory + following.desc: A stacked inventory with Equip Best. Equipped pets follow you on every client: walkers hop behind you and flyers hover, snapped to the ground below them.

pets & rng/pets breaking coins.title: Pets Breaking Coins
pets & rng/pets breaking coins.desc: Click a coin pile and your pets run over and attack it. Each hit is dealt by the server with the pet's power, shown as a damage number, and coins are split by damage dealt.

pets & rng/safe break.title: Safe Break
pets & rng/safe break.desc: Rare, high-HP breakables for strong pets: every hit shows its damage, and the safe bursts into coins that fly to the players who broke it.

pets & rng/pet level up.title: Pet Level Up
pets & rng/pet level up.desc: Pets earn XP for every hit and level up, each level adding to their power. A short cutscene shows the pet and its new level.

pets & rng/spin system + ui.title: Gun Skin Spin
pets & rng/spin system + ui.desc: A spin wheel for gun skins with weighted rarities, multi-spin packs and a possible-rewards list. The result is decided on the server before the wheel stops.

pets & rng/emote spin system + ui.title: Emote Spin
pets & rng/emote spin system + ui.desc: The same spin system for emotes, with animated previews of each emote on the wheel.

movement & parkour/parkour.title: Parkour Movement
movement & parkour/parkour.desc: Wall runs, vaults, slides, ledge climbs and double jumps, chained together with automatic vaulting and wall running.

movement & parkour/basic dash.title: Directional Dash
movement & parkour/basic dash.desc: Front, back and side dashes with their own animations, a trail on side dashes, and a sound everyone in range hears.

movement & parkour/walk + run.title: Walk & Sprint
movement & parkour/walk + run.desc: Walking and sprinting with a stamina bar, run animations and camera motion that follows your speed.

ui & systems/pass shop + gifting.title: Gamepass Shop & Gifting
ui & systems/pass shop + gifting.desc: A gamepass shop where any pass can be gifted to a friend picked from your friends list. The purchase is verified before the gift is delivered.

ui & systems/emote shop.title: Emote Shop
ui & systems/emote shop.desc: Browse and buy emotes with live previews on your own character.

ui & systems/emote wheel.title: Emote Wheel
ui & systems/emote wheel.desc: A radial emote wheel: hold to open, pick a slot, and the emote plays for everyone.

ui & systems/custom leaderboard.title: Custom Leaderboard
ui & systems/custom leaderboard.desc: A custom in-game leaderboard that replaces Roblox's default player list.

ui & systems/custom aura pop-up.title: Aura Unlock Pop-Up
ui & systems/custom aura pop-up.desc: An animated pop-up when you unlock an aura, showing which aura you got.

ui & systems/aura selection.title: Aura Selection
ui & systems/aura selection.desc: Pick and equip your auras, each with a preview before you equip it.

ui & systems/gun skins inventory ui.title: Gun Skin Inventory
ui & systems/gun skins inventory ui.desc: Owned gun skins with their rarity, and equipping one updates the gun right away.

ui & systems/emote inventory ui.title: Emote Inventory
ui & systems/emote inventory ui.desc: All your owned emotes in one list, ready to put on the wheel.

ui & systems/emote replace + selection.title: Emote Slot Replace
ui & systems/emote replace + selection.desc: Swap the emote in any wheel slot from your inventory; the menu slides open around the wheel.

ui & systems/sync emote.title: Synced Emotes
ui & systems/sync emote.desc: Join someone's emote and dance in sync: the animations start from the same point and the song is heard once.
